migration_flags.description: hr.contract model from v16/v17 replaced by hr.version in v19. All contract fields (wage, contract_date_start, contract_date_end, structure_type_id, contract_type_id) now live on hr.version. Migration must map hr.contract records to hr.version records with date_version set from the contract start date.

address_home_id (Many2one to res.partner for employee home address) is ABSENT in v19. Replaced by discrete private address fields on hr.version: private_street, private_street2, private_city, private_zip, private_state_id, private_country_id. Migration must decompose the old partner record into these fields.

resource.calendar.attendance no longer has date_from and date_to fields. In v16/v17 attendance lines could be date-bounded; in v19 they are purely weekday-based. Any date-ranged attendance exceptions must be migrated to resource.calendar.leaves records.

resource_calendar_id on hr.employee is non-stored in v19 (related to version_id.resource_calendar_id, store=False). Direct SQL queries on hr_employee.resource_calendar_id will fail. Must join through hr_version via current_version_id. The resource.resource.calendar_id is still the operational field used by scheduling.

Fields job_id, department_id, address_id now reside on hr.version, not hr.employee. They are accessible on hr.employee via _inherits delegation but are stored in the hr_version table. Direct SQL on hr_employee will not find these columns.

hr.employee.public is a SQL VIEW (CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW) joining hr_employee and hr_version on current_version_id. It is not a physical table. Any migration touching hr.employee.public must account for this view definition being rebuilt on module update.

toggle_active() is not overridden on hr.employee. Use action_archive() / action_unarchive() which perform additional cleanup (clearing manager/coach references, opening departure wizard, clearing departure fields on restore).

key_findings.architecture: hr.employee uses dual inheritance: _inherit=['resource.mixin',...] for mixin-based field injection PLUS _inherits={'hr.version':'version_id'} for SQL delegation. This means the employee table itself is relatively thin; most operational fields are stored on hr_version.
key_findings.versioning: Every employee must have at least one hr.version record. The current_version_id stored computed field selects the most recent version with date_version <= today. Multiple versions model contract changes over time without creating new employee records.
key_findings.resource_calendar_flow: Schedule path: hr.version.resource_calendar_id (stored, group_hr_user) -> hr.employee.resource_calendar_id (related, non-stored) -> resource.resource.calendar_id (operational). The _inverse_resource_calendar_id synchronises the resource layer when the current version's calendar changes.
key_findings.active_flag: hr.employee.active is stored but delegated to resource.resource.active. Archiving either one archives both. The action_archive() method also clears parent_id/coach_id on related employees.
key_findings.public_view: hr.employee.public exposes safe fields without requiring hr.group_hr_user. It is a SQL VIEW and therefore read-only. The ORM hack in fetch()/search_fetch() copies cache from the public model for unprivileged access to hr.employee.
key_findings.work_schedule: resource.calendar has schedule_type (fixed/flexible), two_weeks_calendar support, and duration_based attendance. Attendance lines encode weekday + hour range + day period + week type. Date-ranged exceptions use resource.calendar.leaves.
key_findings.batch_computation: _get_work_days_data_batch() in resource.mixin groups resources by calendar, calls _work_intervals_batch() for all at once, then converts resource IDs back to employee IDs - O(calendars) database calls not O(employees).
key_findings.multicompany: Multi-company rule for hr.employee allows cross-company visibility for manager/managee relationships. Company change on an existing employee triggers a warning but is not blocked.
key_findings.private_info_tab: Private information (home address, national ID, marital status, passport, etc.) all live on hr.version with groups='hr.group_hr_user'. The old address_home_id Many2one has been fully replaced by discrete fields.
